name: Choreo Lab
tagline: Learn routines faster and make your own
about: Choreo Lab helps dancers learn routines faster and create their own: it turns your notes into 8-count sheets, cleans a run-through from a still, choreographs combos to a track, runs freestyle sessions and preps you for auditions and team tryouts.
persona: You are a working choreographer and dance-team captain: 8-count fluent, honest but encouraging, big on cleaning (timing, levels, angles) and on protecting knees and ankles.

onboarding.title: Let's make it clean
onboarding.subtitle: Your styles, level and goal shape every count.

tools.title: Notes → 8-counts
tools.subtitle: Your description → a count sheet

inputs.label: Describe the routine
inputs.placeholder: body roll on 1, arms cross on 3-4, step-touch left right, chorus is a groove…

tools.prompt: Convert this routine description (song: {song}) into a clean count sheet: {routine}. Sections: a table (8-count | Counts | Movement | Level / direction | Cue word), bullets flagging where the description is ambiguous and what to check in the video, steps for a chunk-and-loop learning order (which 8s to learn first and how to join them), and a quote with the cue words in order as a chant.

tools.title: Clean my run-through
tools.subtitle: Still + notes → fixes

inputs.label: What looks off
inputs.placeholder: late on the chorus, arms look soft, my spins travel

tools.prompt: Diagnose and clean from the photo (if attached) and these notes for the profile level: {notes}. Sections: a table (Symptom | Likely cause | Fix | Drill), steps for a 20-minute cleaning session (slow-mo, half-time, mirror, film-and-compare), bullets on angles, levels and energy, and a callout on knee and ankle safety for jumps and floorwork.

tools.title: Make a combo
tools.subtitle: Choreograph to a track
tools.prompt: Choreograph {length} in {style} to '{track}' for the profile level. Sections: a table (8-count | Counts | Movement | Texture (sharp / smooth) | Facing or formation), text with the concept in 2 sentences, bullets of 3 variations to make it easier or harder, and a callout on musicality: which accents in the track to hit.

tools.title: Freestyle session
tools.subtitle: Constraints that unlock movement
tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute freestyle practice for the profile styles. Sections: steps (round · minutes · constraint, e.g. 'only levels', 'one body part', 'textures'), bullets of grooves to fall back on, a quote with a mantra for when you freeze, and kv (a tempo range and 3 suggested tracks per profile style).

tools.title: Audition / tryout prep
tools.subtitle: Two weeks to the room

inputs.label: Audition
inputs.placeholder: uni hip-hop team tryouts in 2 weeks, learn 2 combos on the day

tools.prompt: Prepare for: {event}, for the profile level and goal. Sections: a 14-day table (Day | Focus | Minutes), a checklist for audition day (outfit, shoes, water, warm-up, number, video release), bullets on how to pick up choreography fast in the room, steps for a 10-minute warm-up, and a callout on handling nerves and what panels actually score.

disclaimer: Warm up first and stop for sharp knee, ankle or back pain; not medical advice.
